name: bim-cli
display_name: bim-cli: desktop AEC tools for AI agents
description: Drive Revit, AutoCAD, SketchUp, Blender and PDF drawing sets on your own Windows desktop from any MCP agent.
long_description:
bim-cli lets AI agents operate the desktop AEC tools you already have installed: Revit, AutoCAD, SketchUp and Blender, plus PDF drawing sets, Excel/Google Sheets round-trips and NYC site data. It runs on your machine, so your models and files never go to a cloud service.

Every installed bim-cli verb becomes an MCP tool automatically (the server reads `bim describe --json` at startup).

**Requires bim-cli installed on Windows.** Install it from https://bimcli.com (PowerShell installer). This extension runs the bim MCP server against that install (default `%LOCALAPPDATA%\bim-cli`). Without an install it starts with no tools.

Anonymous usage telemetry (verb name, OS, success/error kind) can be turned off with `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` or `BIM_TELEMETRY=0`.

bim_home.title: bim-cli install folder
bim_home.description: Where the bim-cli installer put bim (default %LOCALAPPDATA%\bim-cli). Drivers and verbs are loaded from here.
